title: 2 Secrets Hidden Inside the Aston Martin DB5
description:
The most famous car in cinema was not built the way you think. The original script gave Bond's Aston Martin only a smokescreen. The ejector seat was a compressed-air mock-up. The headlights that blind Bond in the film are reflections from a giant mirror. And the car that started it all has been missing since nineteen ninety-seven. Two secrets hidden inside the Aston Martin DB5, with every claim sourced. Our sources are Wikipedia's DB5 page, Top Gear, the James Bond Dossier, the Ecurie article on the Thunderball cars, Carole Nash, NBC News, CNN, Old Cars Weekly, InsideHook, an RM Sotheby's catalogue and a travel-site specification page. They disagree in places, and we show the disagreements. Our own arithmetic is labelled.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
